name: Lotad
description: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

moves.name: Growl
moves.description: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.

moves.name: Astonish
moves.description: The user attacks the target while shouting in a startling fashion. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Absorb
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Water Gun
moves.description: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

moves.name: Mist
moves.description: The user cloaks itself and its allies in a white mist that prevents any of their stats from being lowered for five turns.

moves.name: Mega Drain
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Flail
moves.description: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move’s power.

moves.name: Bubble Beam
moves.description: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. This may also lower the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Nature Power
moves.description: This attack makes use of nature’s power. Its effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Surf
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Thief
moves.description: The user attacks and steals the target’s held item simultaneously. The user can’t steal anything if it already holds an item.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon’s Speed stats.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves. It lowers the power of Water-type moves.

moves.name: Whirlpool
moves.description: The user traps the target in a violent swirling whirlpool for four to five turns.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

moves.name: Hail
moves.description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.description: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the target two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Seed Bomb
moves.description: The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move’s power.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.

moves.name: Scald
moves.description: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Grassy Glide
moves.description: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.

moves.name: Counter
moves.description: A retaliation move that counters any physical attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

moves.name: Leech Seed
moves.description: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.

moves.name: Razor Leaf
moves.description: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at opposing Pokémon. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Sweet Scent
moves.description: A sweet scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon’s evasiveness.

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moves.name: Teeter Dance
moves.description: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses the Pokémon around it.

moves.name: Tickle
moves.description: The user tickles the target into laughing, reducing its Attack and Defense stats.
